caption_and_notices.meta_description: ARABIAN GULF (Jan. 14, 2014) An E2-C Hawkeye, attached to the French aircraft carrier FS Charles de Gaulle (R 91), lands on the flight deck of the aircraft carrier USS Harry S. Truman (CVN 75) during carrier qualification integration. Harry S. Truman, flagship for the Harry S. Truman Carrier Strike Group, is conducting operations with units assigned to French Task Force 473 to enhance levels of cooperation and interoperability, enhance mutual maritime capabilities and promote long-term regional stability in the U.S. 5th Fleet area of responsibility (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Karl Anderson/Released)
